title: 矿产品出口收货人信息冲突与合规放行谈判
english: Export consignee mismatch and compliant release negotiation

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 慢读三遍，重点区分 provisional 与 final。
lines: Provisional acceptance
暂定验收
Document reconciliation
单证勾稽
Origin declaration
原产地声明
Beneficial ownership
最终受益所有权
Conditional release
有条件放行

modules.title: 10高频词/短语
modules.hint: 每个短语造一句矿业业务句。
lines: Certificate of origin
原产地证明
Export permit
出口许可证
Packing list
装箱单
Commercial invoice
商业发票
Traceability record
溯源记录
Consignee details
收货人资料
Net dry weight
净干重
Payment milestone
付款节点
Documentary discrepancy
单证不一致
Written waiver
书面豁免

modules.title: 10核心句
modules.hint: 按照核查、拒绝、升级、放行的顺序练习。
lines: The certificate of origin has not been issued yet.
原产地证明尚未签发。
Please reconcile the consignee name across all documents.
请核对所有文件中的收货人名称。
The export permit must cover this mineral and shipment.
出口许可证必须涵盖该矿种和这批货物。
We cannot rely on a draft certificate for customs clearance.
我们不能用证明草稿办理海关清关。
The packing list shows a different number of bags.
装箱单显示的袋数不同。
Please verify the net dry weight before invoicing.
开票前请核实净干重。
A request to backdate documents must be rejected.
必须拒绝倒签文件的要求。
The payment milestone depends on verified documents.
付款节点取决于单证核验。
Keep the truck in the approved secure holding area.
请让车辆停在获准的安全待命区。
We will release the shipment only after written clearance.
我们只会在取得书面放行确认后放货。

modules.title: 金额/吨位/品位/汇率口述
modules.hint: 以下均为教学假设，不是市场报价。先慢速读数字，再在30秒内复述。
lines: The gross weight is fourteen thousand eight hundred kilograms.
模拟毛重为14800公斤。
The moisture deduction is three percent.
模拟扣水率为3%。
The calculated dry weight is fourteen point three five six metric tonnes.
计算干重为14.356公吨。
The assay grade is fifty-eight point two percent tin.
模拟锡品位为58.2%。
The indicative price is eighteen thousand US dollars per dry tonne.
模拟参考价为每干吨18000美元。
The illustrative invoice amount is two hundred fifty-eight thousand four hundred and eight dollars.
模拟发票金额为258408美元。
The exercise exchange rate is one dollar to one thousand five hundred francs.
练习汇率为1美元兑1500法郎。
At that rate, the invoice is three hundred eighty-seven million six hundred twelve thousand francs.
按该汇率发票金额为387612000法郎。
Please state whether the price applies to dry tonnes or contained metal.
请说明价格按干吨还是含金属量计价。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 每句跟读五次；最后不看文字完成一分钟复述。
lines: The shipment is ready, but two export documents still contain inconsistent consignee details.
货物已备妥，但两份出口单证的收货人资料仍不一致。
We must reconcile the commercial invoice, packing list, export permit and origin documents before release.
放行前必须核对商业发票、装箱单、出口许可证及原产地文件。
If the deadline is missed, we will notify the buyer and reschedule the truck rather than falsify records.
如果错过截止时间，我们将通知买家并重新安排车辆，而不是伪造记录。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 一人问、一人答，交换角色后再练。
lines: Did the documentation team receive the revised packing list?
单证团队收到修订装箱单了吗？
Yes, they received it this morning and are checking the bag count.
收到了，今天早上收到，正在核对袋数。
Is the driver comfortable waiting at the secure yard?
司机在安全停车场等候是否方便？
He is safe, and we have informed him about the expected delay.
他很安全，我们已经告知预计延误。
Thank you for keeping everyone informed.
谢谢你持续向大家通报。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 压力点一：买家催发货；压力点二：供应商要求先付款。每题先自己回答再读示范。
lines: The buyer says: If you miss today's truck, we will deduct a penalty.
买家表示：如果错过今天的车，我们将扣罚款。
Model response: We acknowledge the deadline, but the consignee mismatch must be corrected before release. Please confirm a revised dispatch window in writing.
示范回答：我们理解截止时间，但收货人不一致必须在放行前纠正。请书面确认新的发运窗口。
The supplier says: Pay the balance now and we will send the origin certificate tomorrow.
供应商表示：现在付清尾款，明天补原产地证明。
Model response: The contract requires verified export documents before the final payment. We can review any undisputed amount through the normal approval process.
示范回答：合同要求尾款支付前核实出口文件。无争议款项可按正常审批流程评估。
Confirm the mineral description, grade basis, bag count and buyer identity across the entire document pack.
请在整套文件中核实矿种描述、品位计价依据、袋数及买方身份。
Never substitute an unrelated origin document or invent a traceability number.
不得使用无关原产地文件替代，也不得编造溯源编号。

modules.title: 运输押运/海关
modules.hint: 压力点三：司机已到口岸，代理要求倒签。训练拒绝并给替代路径。
lines: The customs broker asks us to backdate the origin certificate to avoid a delay.
报关代理要求倒签原产地证明以避免延误。
Model response: We cannot backdate or alter official records. Please request a lawful correction or revised clearance appointment.
示范回答：我们不能倒签或篡改官方记录。请申请合法更正或重新预约清关。
Ask the escort officer to record the truck location and current seal number.
要求押运员记录车辆位置及当前封签号。
Do not break the seal while the document discrepancy remains unresolved.
单证差异未解决前不得拆封。
Check whether the actual bag count matches the signed stuffing report.
核实实际袋数是否与签署的装柜报告一致。
Escalate any unexplained route deviation to logistics and compliance.
任何无法解释的路线偏离均应上报物流与合规。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三轮各5分钟：先陈述决定，再解释风险，最后提出可执行替代方案。
lines: Round one: You are the exporter. The buyer demands immediate release despite a consignee mismatch.
第一轮：你是出口方，买家在收货人信息不符的情况下要求立即放货。
Model answer: I cannot authorize release until the consignee details match. I will send a corrected document checklist within thirty minutes.
示范：资料一致前我不能授权放货。我将在30分钟内发送修订文件清单。
Round two: You are the finance manager. A supplier asks for final payment before the certificate arrives.
第二轮：你是财务经理，供应商要求在证明到达前支付尾款。
Model answer: The final payment remains conditional on document verification. Please provide the signed certificate and invoice for review.
示范：尾款仍以单证核验为条件。请提供签署的证明和发票供审核。
Round three: You are the logistics lead. The driver is waiting and the broker suggests backdating paperwork.
第三轮：你是物流负责人，司机正在等候，代理建议倒签单证。
Model answer: We will not backdate records. Keep the cargo secure, document the delay and request the next lawful clearance slot.
示范：我们不会倒签记录。请确保货物安全、记录延误并申请下一个合法清关时段。
Close each round by confirming who owns the next action and when they will report back.
每轮结束时确认下一步责任人及反馈时间。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 遮住英文后听写，再对照检查冠词、介词和拼写。
lines: The consignee name must match on every document.
每份单证的收货人名称必须一致。
Please send the corrected packing list today.
请今天发送修订装箱单。
We cannot backdate the origin certificate.
我们不能倒签原产地证明。
The truck will remain in the secure holding area.
车辆将在安全待命区继续等候。
Payment is subject to compliance approval.
付款须经合规审批。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 每题45秒，采用决定、原因、证据、下一步四句结构。
lines: What would you do if the consignee name differs between the invoice and the export permit?
发票和出口许可证上的收货人名称不同，你会怎么做？
How would you explain a lawful shipment delay to an impatient buyer?
如何向不耐烦的买家解释合法的发运延误？
What documents should be verified before final payment?
支付尾款前应核验哪些文件？
How would you refuse a request to backdate a certificate?
如何拒绝倒签证明的要求？
What information must the escort officer record during a delay?
延误期间押运员必须记录哪些信息？

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.hint: 复习Day28—30的核心风险，不要求历史欠课齐全。
lines: Day twenty-eight: Verify any beneficiary-account change through an independent channel.
第28课：通过独立渠道核验收款账户变更。
Day twenty-nine: Do not lock a purchase price before understanding the downstream pricing exposure.
第29课：未明确下游点价风险敞口前不要仓促锁定采购价。
Day thirty: Reconcile the invoice weight, packing list and customs declaration.
第30课：核对发票重量、装箱单与报关申报。
Today's rule: Never release cargo using inconsistent or falsified export documents.
今日原则：不得依据不一致或伪造的出口文件放货。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 先逐句读，再合并为90秒完整口头汇报。
lines: Good morning. I am reporting a documentation discrepancy affecting today's proposed mineral shipment.
早上好，我汇报今天计划发运矿产品的一项单证差异。
The cargo has been weighed and secured, but the consignee details differ between the invoice and export paperwork.
货物已称重并妥善保管，但发票与出口文件中的收货人信息不一致。
Our documentation team is reconciling the export permit, certificate of origin, packing list and signed stuffing report.
单证团队正在核对出口许可证、原产地证明、装箱单和签署的装柜报告。
The buyer has requested immediate dispatch, while the supplier is asking for the final payment.
买家要求立即发运，同时供应商要求支付尾款。
We cannot release the cargo or approve a conditional payment without completing the applicable checks.
在完成适用核验前，我们不能放行货物或批准附条件付款。
The truck will remain at an approved secure location, and the escort officer will document the delay and seal condition.
车辆将停在获准的安全地点，押运员将记录延误和封签状态。
We will not backdate certificates, change factual shipment data or bypass traceability requirements.
我们不会倒签证明、篡改真实发运数据或绕过溯源要求。
By four p.m. Kigali time, we will provide a corrected document status, responsible persons and a revised dispatch proposal.
我们将在基加利时间下午四点前提供修订单证状态、责任人及新的发运建议。
Thank you for your patience. Our priority is a lawful, traceable and commercially controlled shipment.
感谢耐心等待。我们的首要目标是合法、可溯源且商业风险可控的发运。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 总计75分钟；按顺序完成并记录三次压力决策。
lines: Spend eight minutes on pronunciation and ten minutes on key expressions.
发音练习8分钟，高频表达10分钟。
Spend ten minutes on core sentences and eight minutes on numerical speaking.
核心句10分钟，数字口述8分钟。
Spend six minutes on shadowing and four minutes on small talk.
跟读6分钟，寒暄4分钟。
Spend eight minutes on operations and escort instructions.
业务与押运训练8分钟。
Complete the fifteen-minute role-play without skipping any decision.
完整完成15分钟角色扮演，不跳过任何决策。
Spend four minutes on dictation, speaking and review.
听写、口语与复习4分钟。
Spend two minutes delivering the final briefing.
完整陈述2分钟。
